facts.fact: Headmistress Miss Jagerson greets the applicant as “Miss Philomela Fen” and asks her to shake hands instead of standing on ceremony.
facts.anchor: Please do shake my hand, my dear. Let’s not stand on ceremony.

facts.fact: Phil tells Miss Jagerson that her father (Papa) lost all the family's money.
facts.anchor: It’s my Papa,’ she confessed. ‘He’s lost all our money.

facts.fact: Phil states that Cressida is her little sister and that Mamma was busy looking after her.
facts.anchor: with looking after Cressida – she’s my little sister

facts.fact: Phil says Papa went big game hunting in Africa and an elephant stood on him.
facts.anchor: An elephant stood on him. Possibly several elephants.

facts.fact: Miss Jagerson tells Phil that Latin is a required subject for the first three years.
facts.anchor: Latin is a required subject here for the first three years

facts.fact: Phil says Mamma had power of attorney while Papa was unconscious in hospital.
facts.anchor: while he was unconscious she had power of attorney

facts.fact: Miss Jagerson asks Phil to take a class of the girls for a sample lesson.
facts.anchor: I’d like to see you take a class of the girls for a sample lesson.

facts.fact: Phil says she can no longer confine herself to her own research now that she has got her PhD.
facts.anchor: confine myself to my own research any longer, now that I’ve got my PhD
